question: A slope has a slope ratio of \(1:\sqrt{3}\). Find its angle of slope in degrees.
solution: The slope ratio equals the tangent of the angle of slope: \(\tan\alpha=1/\sqrt{3}=\sqrt{3}/3\), so \(\alpha=30^\circ\).
